actions.title: Improper License Display
actions.action: Display the FSSAI license/registration prominently at the entry of the food business premises.

actions.title: Improper Protective Attire
actions.action: Ensure all food handlers wear clean protective attire, including headgear and footwear, while on duty.

actions.title: Absence of Date Tagging
actions.action: Affix legible date tags to all stored food articles and maintain batch-wise traceability and stock-rotation records.

actions.title: Unclean Premises
actions.action: Maintain the entire food premises, including all food-contact surfaces, in a clean and hygienic condition at all times.

actions.title: Use of Artificial Colours
actions.action: Discontinue the use of artificial colours except as permitted under the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, and declare permitted colours on the label.
